name: Forerunner
description: The pan's second arrival, the one that comes for you: a tiger beetle, the fastest thing on legs, which runs so fast it goes blind and has to stop to see — the game runs it as a sprint and a rest (EnemyType.hopSpeed) and it fires only in the rest. Seen from above along +x and turned by the game rather than mirrored, like the Courser: a long moss-green body with cream spots on the elytra, a narrow thorax, a big head with two frost eyes, six very long legs at full stride, and jaws — two husk sickles longer than the head, the read at any distance, and the mouth the glass fan leaves from (`ss.enemy.glassbolt`; the `spit` clip flares an aqua glint there). Green, the pan's one green besides the Locust, which is chaff. `enraged` lifts the elytra to show venom-green hind wings, lights the spots ember and lengthens the jaws. Gameplay radius 42. The `death` clip splays the long legs flat and opens the elytra.

enraged.description: Halfway: the elytra lifted to show the venom hind wings under them, the spots and eyes gone ember, the jaws longer and bone-white. It sprints harder and the fan is five.

final.description: Phase three: the elytra are gone rather than lifted, and the wings they were hiding have nothing left in them. The eyes are out — it was only ever blind between stops, and now it is blind in them too. What is left is the running and the jaws.

sprint.description: a full-stride run on six long legs, the body driving forward on every step, the jaws working and the antennae streaming back

spit.description: the jaws gape and the head jerks back and forward; a glass glint flares in the mouth on the frame the fan leaves

death.description: the jaws snap once and fall wide, the elytra lift and the venom-green hind wings show under them, the long legs splay out flat, the eyes dim, the antennae fall back and the organ goes out
